system.description:
Gazing into the glazed eyes of a corpse, you call up the final moment burned into it, reading the memory of death itself in a rush of jarring flashes and sensations.

Expend a Mental Trait while gazing into the eyes of a corpse; no challenge is required. You immediately witness the last minute of the individual's existence as flashes of vision and startling sensations. This works even on a vampire who has met Final Death, provided he had not achieved Golconda and is not in advanced decomposition, but it does not function on vampires that are still ambulatory.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
